svg.title: Simulated heading on the return straight
svg.desc: Over the same 0.87 m return straight, the solid blue trace (P = 2, D = 1.5) spans 10.2 degrees. The dashed red trace (P = 4, D = 0.01) spans 31.5 degrees.

cc:Work.dc:title: Simulated heading on the return straight
cc:Work.dc:description: MuJoCo samples at 10 ms intervals, measured over x = −0.45 to +0.42 m on the first return. Both trials use speed 7, I = 0, a 15 mm left starting offset and a fixed 120 ms command delay.
